name: Hester Biosciences Ltd
title: Hester Biosciences Ltd - 524669 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: Poultry-led profit recovery (Q4 revenue +22%, PAT +174%) with Animal Healthcare tender delays unresolved and no hard FY27 guidance; capacity built, BSL-3 underused, receivables rising to INR 92 crore.

triggers.label: BSL-3 facility underused, optimisation underway
triggers.quote: we are also undertaking optimization initiatives aligned with our current operational and scale -up requirements

triggers.label: Receivables INR 92 crore on sub-INR 300 crore revenue
triggers.quote: our receivables of INR 92 crores on revenue of less than INR 300 crores seems to be quite high

triggers.label: Poultry revenue +41% in Q4
triggers.quote: growing by 41% in Q4 and 21% for the entire financial year

triggers.label: Animal Healthcare recovery promised, not quantified
triggers.quote: from Q4, it did start to pick up

guidance.quote: we are going to recover it from this quarter onwards

red_flags.label: Receivables stretched, bad-debt write-offs INR 6.5 crore
red_flags.quote: we have some write -offs of around INR 6.5 crores on account of bad debts

red_flags.label: Profit boosted by exceptional financial income from stake sale
red_flags.quote: profitability during the year also benefited from exceptional fin ancial income

red_flags.label: Animal Healthcare revenue down ~30% YoY
red_flags.quote: our Animal Healthcare revenue fell year -on-year by 30%

evasions.quote: I think we are getting too deep into these questions, breakup and etc.
We are just referring to numbers. Just give us a minute.
there cannot be a definitive answer whether we will be allocating any more capital or this is it
